operations.name: GetServiceCapabilities
operations.description: Returns the capabilities of the receiver service. The result is returned in a typed answer.

fields.name: Capabilities

attributes.name: RTP_Multicast
attributes.description: Indicates that the device can receive RTP multicast streams.

attributes.name: RTP_TCP
attributes.description: Indicates that the device can receive RTP/TCP streams

attributes.name: RTP_RTSP_TCP
attributes.description: Indicates that the device can receive RTP/RTSP/TCP streams.

attributes.name: SupportedReceivers
attributes.description: The maximum number of receivers supported by the device.

attributes.name: MaximumRTSPURILength
attributes.description: The maximum allowed length for RTSP URIs (Minimum and default value is 128 octet).

fields.description: The capabilities for the receiver service is returned in the Capabilities element.

operations.name: GetReceivers
operations.description: Lists all receivers currently present on a device. This operation is mandatory.

fields.name: Receivers

definition.name: Receiver
definition.description: Description of a receiver, including its token and configuration.

fields.name: Token

definition.name: ReferenceToken
definition.description:
Unique identifier for a physical or logical resource.
			Tokens should be assigned such that they are unique within a device. Tokens must be at least unique within its class.
			Length up to 64 characters. Token may be extended by intermediate terminal with adding prefix to make it global unique.
			The length should be within 36 characters for generating at local device. See "Remote Token" section in Resource Query specification.

fields.description: Unique identifier of the receiver.
